infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
The director of Rhine Lab's Originium Art Section, Dorothy chose to use her given name as her codename aboard Rhodes Island.
Miss Dorothy Franks is joining Rhodes Island as the project leader of our collaboration with Rhine Lab, and will be lending us her assistance in our research projects. As the director of their Originium Art Section, her expertise on the subject is beyond question, and her Originium Arts applications are unparalleled.
text.zh:
莱茵生命源石技艺应用科主任，在罗德岛选择使用自己的本名作为代号。
多萝西·弗兰克斯小姐以“莱茵生命与罗德岛的合作项目负责人”这一身份加入我们，将会在许多研究项目上为罗德岛提供帮助。身为源石技艺应用科的主任，她对源石技艺本身的理解毋庸置疑，而在源石技艺的应用上更是炉火纯青。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Dorothy shows no signs of Originium infection.
However, we all know that there exists something in her body that is no less dangerous than Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Dorothy is frequently immersed in a variety of experiments closely related to Originium. Although she uses adequate safety precautions, extra attention is necessary.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员多萝西目前没有被源石感染的迹象。
但我们都知道，她体内存在的某些东西，危险程度或许不亚于源石感染。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员多萝西长期埋首于与源石密切相关的种种实验，尽管防护措施齐全，但仍需额外注意。

text.en:
The first time Dorothy Franks came aboard the Rhodes Island landship was when Rhine Lab was in the initial stages of quelling the disturbance that occurred in the outskirts of Trimounts, not long after the arrest warrant for Energy Director Ferdinand Clooney was issued for his illegal experiments. It was around this time that Operator Dorothy proposed to us a mutually beneficial collaborative project that would become the highest level collaboration between Rhine Lab and Rhodes Island to date—a project that is not only managed directly by a Rhine section director, but also necessitated said director's dispatchment to Rhodes Island.
Given her sensitive position, we must make this clear: despite her employment as a section director at Rhine Lab, Operator Dorothy never flaunts her position.
The reason we always bring up her position when we introduce her to others is that it is the best way to throw a spotlight on both her life and her most attention-worthy talent. She is one of the most outstanding leaders among Rhine Lab's many researchers, and one of the foremost experts in the field of Originium Arts applications. Some of us have seen for ourselves the results of the research projects she's been personally involved in.
Although ultimately the former Energy Section Director Clooney was established as the mastermind behind the incident, there is no doubt that it is this lady with a bright smile on her face who produced the results of those dangerous experiments.
text.zh:
多萝西·弗兰克斯女士在罗德岛舰内的初次亮相，是莱茵生命初步平息发生在特里蒙城郊的骚乱，能量科主任斐尔迪南·克鲁尼因涉嫌非法实验而正式遭通缉之后不久。干员多萝西正是在这样的时间点，带着一份于双方都有益的合作项目，促成了莱茵生命与罗德岛目前为止最高等级的合作——由一科主任亲自负责，并执行派遣。
对于这位身份敏感的女士，首先需要申明的一点的是：在莱茵生命享有的主任头衔，绝非干员多萝西用来装点自己的一种炫耀手段。
我们屡次在介绍干员多萝西时提及她的这一职位，只是因为这最能够直观展现出干员多萝西的生平与其最值得瞩目的才能，她是莱茵生命众多研究者中最出众的代表之一，她是源石技艺应用领域专家中的专家，她经手主导的研究项目曾造成怎样的后果，我们之中的一些人曾亲眼目睹。
尽管从结论上来说，曾经的能量科主任斐尔迪南被认为是这场事件的罪魁祸首，但不能否认的是，那些危险的实验成果，正是我们面前这位笑意盈盈的女士一手造就的。

text.en:
Operator Dorothy was born to a family of immigrants from Sargon. Her father was a civilian medic who practiced medicine in the wilderness, while her mother was a Pioneer.
As her father was often away, Dorothy was raised alone by her Pioneer mother. The sandy barrenlands became her most familiar sight during childhood, and her mother's fellow Pioneers became the people she was closest to besides her parents. She liked to write about each member of the Pioneer Team in her diary, and saw them all as irreplaceable family members.
As the descendant of Pioneers, Dorothy's mother also became a Pioneer who worked in the wastes, but evidently she did not want her daughter following in her footsteps. Dorothy had demonstrated extraordinary talent since childhood, with her grades in school far exceeding those of other children her age. Her parents were elated, and they worked hard to pay for her schooling and save for her college tuition so she would never have cause to worry financially. In today's Columbia, as long as someone has enough talent, they have the opportunity to leap up the social ladder, even the children of Pioneers. There is no way but up for the gifted. Of course, this also means that those without the qualifications already have their lives set in stone. However, at the very least, her parents truly believed that she had a much brighter future than theirs ahead of her.
Dorothy went on to meet their expectations as she grew up, her excellence obvious to all those around her. Her family celebrated when she received Ironforge Polytechnic's invitation to participate in its summer camp, not knowing that this would be the last time they would all be together. Dorothy's mother was killed along with many of her Pioneer Team members when a Catastrophe struck the temporary base they were in.
Dorothy's father tried very hard to console his distressed daughter, but was largely unable to do so. However, when she finally emerged from her room after locking herself inside for a few days, her sorrow seemed to have largely died down.
Surely, she'd already found her direction by then.
text.zh:
干员多萝西出生在萨尔贡的一个移民家庭，她的父亲是一名在荒野上行医的民间医师，母亲则是一名拓荒者。
因为父亲常年四处行医，多萝西由身为拓荒者的母亲一手带大，黄沙漫天的荒野一直是多萝西童年生活中最熟悉的风景。母亲所在拓荒队中的叔叔阿姨们，就是多萝西除双亲外最熟悉亲近的人，她喜欢将每一位拓荒队的成员都写进她的日记中，他们都是她重要的家人。
多萝西的母亲作为拓荒者的后代，同样在荒野上成为了一名拓荒者，但她显然并不希望女儿步自己的后尘。多萝西自小便展现出了非凡的天赋，成绩优异远超同龄的其他孩子。这让她的父母异常欣喜，他们努力供女儿读书，为她攒下足够进入大学的积蓄，让多萝西可以不必为物质上的问题而太过烦恼。在现如今的哥伦比亚，只要一个人有足够的才能，就算是拓荒者的后代，也有机会借此实现社会阶级的飞跃。有天资者能够凭借天赋向上攀登——换句话说，资质不佳的人在哥伦比亚的命运，也似乎已有定论。至少多萝西的父母完全相信，他们的女儿会有一个远比他们要更加光明美好的未来。
多萝西一如父母期盼的那样顺利成长，她的优秀有目共睹。然而，在接到铸铁城理工大学的夏令营邀请时，为此欢庆的一家人没有人能够料到，这一次分离就是永别。在天灾的袭击下，多萝西母亲所在的临时基地被整个摧毁，母亲与许多拓荒队成员惨死其中。
多萝西的父亲曾在事后尝试安抚情绪失控的女儿，但收效甚微。而将自己关在房间闭门不出数日后，再度拉开房门出现在众人面前的多萝西，看上去已经收敛了悲伤。
想必她在那时，心中就已经隐隐有了方向。

text.en:
Overall, Operator Dorothy gets along very well with her fellow operators during her stays aboard the Rhodes Island landship.
Aside from the laboratories, Dorothy spends the most time in the ship's screening rooms watching black-and-white films, one of her favorite pastimes. There, she sometimes runs into other operators who share the same interest. It wasn't long before she received an invitation to join the movie lovers' club and became part of that small community.
Dorothy is kind and compassionate by nature, and very much enjoys taking care of those around her. Many of our operators have been on the receiving end of her gentle nagging. Unfortunately, though, it seems she rarely counts herself as someone to be taken care of. So even while she is looking out for others, she is often in pretty bad shape herself.
Those who've worked with her before at Rhine Lab have long since gotten used to how worrying she can be. Operator Astgenne often proactively takes on the responsibility of caring for her, which Dorothy always seems a little embarrassed about. But sometimes, she drops her big sister-like facade and opens her eyes wide like a little girl, making all kinds of tiny, inconsequential requests of Astgenne.
That said, based on Operator Silence's observations and reports, it is also worth pointing out that Dorothy can be somewhat biased in her viewpoints, especially when it comes to ideas like 'protecting everyone' and 'making everyone happy.' When these topics are brought up in conversation, she can sometimes suffer minor emotional breakdowns. This deep-rooted obsession grew out of her family's situation and is not so easy to defuse.
text.zh:
总体来说，干员多萝西在罗德岛的派遣期间，与舰内的其他干员相处得十分愉快。
除去待在实验室里的时间，多萝西最常去的地方是舰内的放映室，在那里观看一部黑白电影是她最爱的休闲活动，偶尔也能够遇到拥有同样兴趣的干员。没过多久，她就正式收到了电影爱好小组的邀请，成为了这个小团体的一分子。
而本身性格便温柔可亲的多萝西，实际上还非常喜欢照顾身边的人，许多干员都曾得到她温柔的叮嘱——不过遗憾的是，多萝西似乎经常忘记把自己也算进需要照顾的对象中，常常还在关心身边的人，自己却状况百出起来。
对于这样让人担忧的干员多萝西，曾在莱茵生命与其有过交流的几名干员早已习以为常。干员星源往往会主动承担起照顾多萝西这一职责，而受到照料的多萝西则显得有些羞赧。但有时，也会看到她放下大姐姐的那一面，像个小女孩一样眨着眼睛，拉着干员星源，提一些无伤大雅的小要求。
不过，同样需要注意的是，经干员赫默的观察及报告，我们发觉干员多萝西在交谈中的一些观点确实存在一定程度的偏执，尤其是在“保护所有人”“让大家幸福”这些方面。干员多萝西在涉及这类话题时偶尔会出现情绪的轻微失控，这种执念因她的家庭遭遇而生，根深蒂固，难以劝解。

text.en:
According to Operator Dorothy herself, in contrast to company veterans such as Saria and Ferdinand, she is the Rhine Lab section director to have most recently joined the company. Originally, Rhine Lab consisted only of nine sections. It was not until she jumped ship from a government research institute, along with her projects, that the tech company heavily supported by the Columbian government formed its Originium Art Section, thus creating its ten-section structure.
At Rhine Lab, Dorothy's relationship with the other section directors is not bad in general. At the very least, they are able to stay amicable enough on the surface. Even Ferdinand, generally known to be difficult to get along with, has given her plenty of assistance with her research. Although she was aware that his help came at a high price, no price was too high when she was about to achieve her dream.

[Voice Log]
'Yes, I was the last one to join. Kristen, Saria, Ferdinand, and Parvis were the original members.'
'Oh, I guess that might cause confusion. It was Kristen and Saria who started the company. Ferdinand and Parvis were the first ones to join them.'
'Just like me, they brought their projects with them. Rhine Lab has always been taking in members like us. All of us have stable, workable projects. Kristen gave us a platform, and we gave back to the company with our results.'
'It was Kristen who approached me back then. She understood my research, and was willing to give me the support I needed. When they hired me, the project that Parvis handed to Olivia had just gone wrong... Oh, it's not as bad as it sounds. An experiment had failed, that's all.'
'The company was in a huge mess because of Director Saria. That was the first time I saw Kristen like that. Perhaps that was when Ferdinand started coming up with his plans.'
'As for what happened this time... Ferdinand's got his own ideas, and I'm not in a position to judge his actions when I was also involved.'
'Parvis? Hm...'
'Most of the time, he's very easy to talk to. He doesn't offend anyone. You could have tea with him, listen to music, and it's all fine.'
'But Parvis is a researcher, too. So is Ferdinand, so is Kristen. And so am I.'
'Well, I really didn't want to put it this way, but...'
'Doctor, I'm sure you know what I mean. We're so alike, after all.'
text.zh:
据干员多萝西本人透露，她与公司元老塞雷娅、斐尔迪南等人不同，是莱茵生命主任级的成员中最晚加入的一个，同时也是最后一个。原本的莱茵生命还只有九科，直到她从政府研究机关带着项目跳槽来到这家受哥伦比亚重点扶持的科技企业，莱茵生命的源石技艺应用科才成立，十科并立的架构就此成型。
在莱茵生命公司内部，多萝西与其他科主任之间的关系总体来说并不算差，至少能够维持表面上的和睦。在她的实验领域，就连公认难以相处的斐尔迪南，也曾给过她不少帮助。就算心知斐尔迪南的帮助总是“价值不菲”，但在自己想要达成的那个目标面前，要付出的代价并不被当时的多萝西看在眼里。

【语音记录】
“是的，我是最后加入的一个。克丽斯腾、塞雷娅、斐尔迪南还有帕尔维斯，他们都是最初的成员。”
“哦，这么说或许你会误会，最初是克丽斯腾和塞雷娅两个人创办了公司，斐尔迪南和帕尔维斯都是最先响应的那一拨人。”
“和我一样，都是自己带着项目来的。莱茵生命一直在吸纳这样的成员，我们有稳定成型、可实施性强的项目，克丽斯腾给我们提供平台，而我们用成果反哺莱茵生命。”
“当时，是克丽斯腾找上了我，她了解我的研究，并且愿意给我支持。我加入时，帕尔维斯交给奥利维亚的项目刚刚出了差错……啊，这其实没什么，只是一个实验失败了而已。”
“公司内部是因塞雷娅主任的事乱成一团，我头一次见克丽斯腾那样，或许从那时候开始，斐尔迪南就已经有了一些打算。”
“这一次的事……斐尔迪南有他自己的想法，我没法评价他的所作所为，毕竟这也与我有关。”
“帕尔维斯吗？嗯……”
“大部分时候，他都是很好说话的人，不会得罪其他人。你可以和帕尔维斯一起喝喝茶，听听音乐，这都没问题。”
“但是帕尔维斯也是研究者。斐尔迪南是，克丽斯腾是，我也是。”
“哎，我真不想这么和你说……”
“博士，我相信你可以理解我的意思，毕竟……我们如此相似。”

text.en:
Both Dorothy Franks's words and actions are sincere. There is no doubt about that. Nonetheless, behind that sincerity lies an element of danger, which we must not underestimate simply because this researcher possesses a warm smile, an attentive gaze, and genuine concern for others. Even though the crisis caused by the experiment has died down and Operator Dorothy has not displayed any dangerous tendencies, we must be aware of the fact that she never has and never will stray from her purpose.
—She truly wishes for everyone to equally find happiness.
Even during her college years, she was already paying close attention to some of Loken Williams's research. From this, we can surmise that whenever Loken gave lectures at the university, Dorothy was likely sitting there in the audience, and was thus influenced by some of his ideals. In particular, her similar attitude towards experimental ethics can be seen in the recent incident. We can only guess what kind of role Rhine Lab had in the 'Loken Watertank' incident, and moreover what kind of part Dorothy herself played. However, none of our guesses are particularly optimistic.
It's also worth noting that it was Operator Saria who first expressed her opinion on Dorothy's onboarding even though she had interacted with her the least during their time at Rhine Lab.
'I know people like her.'
Saria reminded us, 'Be careful. They're the kind of people who will do whatever it takes to achieve what they consider beautiful.'
text.zh:
多萝西·弗兰克斯女士的言行都是真诚的，这一点毋庸置疑。但在这种真诚之中，却始终包藏着一些危险的要素，绝不可以因为对方温和的笑容、专注的视线，以及直白的关怀而低估这位研究者本身所带有的危险性。就算之前的实验风波已平息，目前干员多萝西在与我们的合作中也未表现出任何危险的倾向，但必须明确认识到的是，干员多萝西并未、从未、未来也不会改变她的初衷。
——她真切地希望所有人都平等地得到幸福。
早在大学时代，干员多萝西就已经开始关注洛肯·威廉姆斯的一些研究项目，我们可以猜测，当洛肯在大学演讲时，多萝西或许就坐在台下，因而某些理念深受其影响。尤其是实验伦理观念这一方面，从之前的事件中足可窥见端倪。而莱茵生命在“洛肯水箱”事件中起到怎样的作用，多萝西本人又扮演着什么样的角色，我们不得而知，但所有的猜测都指向并不乐观的方向。
值得注意的是，对于多萝西的加入，反而是在莱茵生命时期与其交集最少的干员塞雷娅率先说出了自己的看法。
“我了解她们那样的人。”
塞雷娅这样提醒我们，“要当心，她们会为了一个‘美好的’想法不顾一切。”
